guard: The packer invokes prepublish guards before packing and inspects archives without tar subprocesses; the publisher enforces secure preflight and disables publication-time lifecycle hooks

mutations.name: Cold candidate skips the prepublish guards
mutations.expectRed: FAIL cold candidate runs prepublish guards before packing
mutations.cell: cold candidate runs prepublish guards before packing

mutations.name: Cold candidate reintroduces a tar inspection subprocess
mutations.expectRed: FAIL cold candidate inspects archives without tar subprocesses
mutations.cell: cold candidate inspects archives without tar subprocesses

mutations.name: Cold candidate accepts repeated archive entries
mutations.find: if (Object.hasOwn(files, name)) throw new Error(`cold candidate has a repeated archive entry: ${entry.path}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL cold candidate refuses repeated archive entries
mutations.cell: cold candidate refuses repeated archive entries

mutations.name: Archive publisher bypasses the secure preflight
mutations.find: const census = await preflight({ root, env, exec, deadline, tag });
mutations.expectRed: FAIL secure preflight refusal prevents every publication
mutations.cell: secure preflight refusal prevents every publication

mutations.name: Archive publisher reruns package lifecycle hooks
mutations.expectRed: FAIL publisher sends only qualified archive paths with provenance and no hooks
mutations.cell: publisher sends only qualified archive paths with provenance and no hooks
